title: Why decentralized identity will replace passwords forever

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Passwords are obsolete. Decentralized identity offers self-sovereign control via protocols like DID and blockchain. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Decentralized systems are too fragmented. No single standard exists, making adoption slow and interoperability a nightmare. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: W3C’s DID specs enable cross-platform identity. Users own keys, avoid password reset hell, and prevent data breaches. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Centralized identity solutions like Microsoft’s Passkeys already offer secure, passwordless login without the overhead of decentralization. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Decentralized identity is a solution in search of a problem—centralized systems are evolving fast. (4 sec)
